assumptions: stake treatment is an explicit scenario input until upstream defines it
locked refundable capital is tracked separately from consumed cost
slashing risk is not monetized without a normative slash condition and probability model
reward inputs are scenario variables and are not FLOP faucet or airdrop parameters
DID count is not operator count
settled work is not automatically independent demand

criteria.requirement: Upstream normatively defines whether agent_identity_min_stake is refundable/locked, burned, slashable, or a precisely specified combination.
Upstream normatively defines the evidence required to classify demand as economically independent.
Upstream defines what protocol-verifiable signals may affect multiple-DID attribution without assuming DID count equals operator count.
E.38/E.40 or successor text normatively defines the Agents allocation/credit formula used for implementation.
Any faucet, testnet credit, or other per-DID benefit relevant to the economic model is normatively specified, including caps and eligibility.
Upstream defines how recycled spend/wash demand is treated for eligibility or allocation credit.

empiricalLane.sourceClaim: Issue #58 reports signature-verifying Technocore observations and offers the dataset/transcripts, but the Lab has not imported or independently verified them.
acceptanceRequirements: publicly retrievable immutable dataset or fixture subset
documented capture scope and sampling limitations
no inference from DID count to operator count without an explicit evidence rule
